audience: marketing and loyalty teams that run referral and loyalty programs in Friendbuy

useCases.title: Review referral performance by campaign
useCases.text: List referral shares, valid clicks and account sign-ups for a date range, filtered by campaign. Compare which campaign sent the most referrals.

useCases.title: Trace purchases and rewards back to referrals
useCases.text: List the purchases attributed to referrals and the referral rewards in a date range.

useCases.title: Check a customer's loyalty balance and coupons
useCases.text: Read a customer's loyalty balance and ledger entries. List the reward coupons the customer received or redeemed.

useCases.title: Confirm that a referral code is active
useCases.text: Check a referral, product-sharing or influencer code. Read its campaign type and status.

useCases.title: Record a purchase for a referral
useCases.text: Record a purchase event so a referral or reward can be attributed to it. This changes Friendbuy data.
